EXTRACTION_POINT_EVENT.title: Extraction Point
EXTRACTION_POINT_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.des: You found an extraction point. Extracting here ends the run: it counts as a defeat, but the items you carry out are deposited in the warehouse (durability is deducted as on a victory; no clear reward).
EXTRACTION_POINT_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.opt: Choose which cards and relics to carry out ([blue]{Capacity}[/blue] capacity this act); potions and gold are carried in full.
Pay [red]{Fee}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] to carry out every card, relic, potion and the remaining gold.
Move on without extracting. No extraction point appears again this run.
EXTRACTION_POINT_EVENT.pages.PASS.descri: You leave the extraction point behind and continue onward.
